exposure: Admission to special care nursery or neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 95 children with idiopathic toe walking (ITW) and 28 children with a medical reason for toe walking
finding: Children with ITW had higher rates of prematurity, special care nursery or NICU admission, and lower birth weights compared to the normative population, suggesting a possible link between birth complications and ITW.
mod_finding: No association was found between assisted-birth intervention and the ITW cohort compared with the normative population or group with a medical cause for toe walking.
followup_time: Mean age 5.8 years (SD 2.9) for ITW group
birth_weight: Lower in ITW group compared to normative population
